notes: Flagged large unit [s007, s008] retained: `בְּתוֹכִי` → *within* is one English word for a preposition on a construct noun, which rule 30 fuses (its own `בְּתוֹךְ` → *among* example), headed on the construct noun; the suffix is aligned separately as rule 30's closing direction requires.
The two *within me*s answer to different morphemes — the first to `עָלַי`, the second to `בְּתוֹכִי` — so rule 22 does not reach either.
The margin's *my spirit fainteth* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
